title: Isolated Stack Licensing playbook + Security Questionnaire response pilot
creator: Aisha Gomez
description: Objective: define a repeatable licensing and support playbook for Private/VPC and on-prem ("isolated stack") customers that balances an upfront licence fee + optional ops credits while reducing friction during Security Questionnaire (SQ) review. Hypothesis: offering three deterministic bundles (Foundation, Business, Mission) with optional accelerated upgrade and hardened-support add-ons will increase conversion for regulated buyers by 18% and reduce SQ turnaround time by 30% versus the current ad-hoc quotes. Scope: packaging rules (license fee ranges, seatless vs seat-based signals, reserved GPU credit bands), support tier definitions, upgrade cadence options and a templated SQ response flow (pre-filled artifact links, dedicated legal hours, prioritized review queue). Out of scope: changing Hosted API pricing or Dedicated commit economics.
comments: 2026-02-21 - Kickoff: aligned with Sales Enablement, Legal, and Solutions Eng. Identified two pilot accounts willing to trial: NovaRetail (retail PLG) and Acero Financial (regulated fintech). Sales requested a seatless option for infra-heavy deployments.

2026-02-26 - Draft pricing matrix uploaded to Google Drive: small/medium/large reserved GPU bands + optional 'Ops Credits' blocks. Link included in artifacts. Legal flagged KMS/HSM integration as an elevated contract clause; we added a conditional fee line.

2026-03-02 - Product review: chose three base bundles (Foundation, Business, Mission) and three add-ons (Accelerated Upgrades, Advanced Security Assist, Extended Hotfix Window). PM asked for measurable success metrics and rollback guardrails.

2026-03-04 - Solutions Eng: created deployment cost model showing break-even at 9 months for Business bundle vs current custom quotes. Uploaded model to /drive/pricing/models/isolated-stack-payback-v1.xlsx

2026-03-06 - Legal review: provided redlines for pre-approved SQ answers, requested a standard CLIN (contract line item) for on-prem encryption handling. Legal estimated 2 business days to produce the first canonical SQ packet.
2026-03-08 - Sales feedback: request to surface sample contract language and an FAQ for procurement teams. Added 'procurement-faq' to artifacts for sprint delivery.

2026-03-10 - Engineering sync: ENG-22107 to confirm upgrade automation feasibility for scheduled minor releases; dependency noted. Decided to pilot manual upgrade windows for Mission tier and automated quarterly upgrades for Business tier.
Next steps: finalize pilot pricing and support SLA table, produce canonical SQ packet, train two AE reps, sign pilot order with NovaRetail (target week of 2026-03-22).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical pricing playbook doc published in Confluence with clear rules for license fee calculation and add-ons
SQ canonical packet (answers + evidence links) approved by Legal and Security and attached to playbook
Two pilot customers contracted under new bundles and invoiced test license fees
Sales enablement deck and procurement FAQ published and 2 AEs trained
Measurement dashboard (conversion, SQ turnaround, average deal TTM) instrumented and visible to PM and Sales leaders
proposed_pricing_matrix: Foundation: low-entry licence fee (~$75k one-time) + minimal ops credits (200 GPU-hours) - target SMB/regulatory-light
Business: mid licence fee (~$225k one-time) + moderate ops credits (1,000 GPU-hours) + tiered discounts for 12/24 month commits
Mission: high licence fee (~$550k one-time) + dedicated ops credits (3,000+ GPU-hours) + SLA-backed uptime + premium security assist
Add-ons: Accelerated Upgrade (paid opt-in), Advanced Security Assist (per-engagement retainer), Onsite/Remote Migration support blocks, KMS/HSM integration setup fee
proposed_support_tiers: Foundation Support: business-hours email support, 5 business-day hotfix window, quarterly roadmap sync
Business Support: 24/5 support, 48-hour P1 response, monthly health check, quarterly minor upgrade automation
Mission Support: 24/7 coverage, 4-hour P1 response, weekly operational sync, on-demand patch windows, named TAM option
upgrade_cadence_options: Manual Ad-hoc: customer-controlled, used for sensitive air-gapped deployments
Quarterly Scheduled: Business tier default - scheduled minor upgrades with opt-out window
Continuous Rolling: Mission tier optional - automated weekly security patches and emergency hotfix plumbing
Guaranteed Emergency Patch SLA: 72-hour emergency patch for all paying tiers with an optional paid expedited 24-hour delivery
